system.description:
You make a single swing with enough force to split to sky and the earth from the weight of your attack alone. All creatures in a 60-foot long, 10 feet wide line, originating from you, must make a Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failed save, affected creatures take your [Weapons damage] + 3d12 of your weapons damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save. The ground tears open and leaves a 10-foot-deep crevasse from the force of your attack. Creatures who fail their saving throw also falls to the bottom of the crevasse.

Chain 3: You can change the shape of this jutsu’s affected area to a 60-foot cone.
